name: Clockify
author: Abdulrahman Rahmouni
description: Clockify time tracker, weekly timesheet, analytics dashboard, and workspace controller in the Omarchy bar: start, stop, split, edit, round, and step timer/manual hours with configurable arrow increments, browse daily/weekly/monthly/yearly charts and grouped history, manage/archive/delete projects, tasks, tags, and clients, track daily/weekly hour targets, and run synced Pomodoro or idle reminders.

barWidget.description: Track time, edit with configurable minute steppers & rounding, view weekly timesheets and analytics reports, manage workspace entities, and run Pomodoro timers from the bar.
